edit.description: renderSchemaForPrompt: make the rejection claim agree with what the composed validator actually accepts
core-field agreement gate driven off the real render and the real parse; bare-core snapshot refresh

summary: renderSchemaForPrompt claims unlisted fields are rejected, but parsePending accepts the unrendered core field observedFiles

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

acceptance: The render's stated rejection claim holds against parsePending for every engine-core field, proven by a gate that derives the field set from the composed validator rather than from a hand-written list.
tests: every engine-core field the composed validator accepts is named in the rendered schema
pins: parsePending accepts an entry carrying every field the rendered schema names
notes: observedFiles (src/PendingSchema.ts:159) is core and accepted; the render (src/PendingSchema.ts:534) omits it while claiming unlisted fields are rejected. Producer-authored it is not (spec/pending.md, observedFiles - the dispatcher's collision record), so naming it as engine-maintained beats listing it as authorable. The standing agreement check (tests/PendingSchema.test.ts:1070) covers extension names only; the bare-core case is an inline snapshot of the writer's own output.
